channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump says no talks scheduled with Iran as he teases action in Hormuz Strait
item.description: Trump insists the U.S., not Iran, is in control of the strait, even though transiting vessels continue to come under attack and few attempt the crossing.

item.title: Bond yields are climbing. Here’s what that means for mortgages and other consumer borrowing
item.description: Long-term government bond yields have risen sharply in recent days. Higher bond yields push consumer borrowing costs up, sometimes immediately.

item.title: Trump, Carney reportedly in talks ahead of new 50% tariffs on Canadian goods
item.description: Trump has already imposed a variety of tariffs on Canada and its specific exports, including metals, lumber and auto parts.

item.title: S&P 500 falls, hurt by elevated global bond yields and oil prices: Live updates
item.description: The S&P 500 fell on Tuesday, pressured by a run in sovereign bond yields to multidecade highs amid concerns of persistent inflation and elevated oil prices.

item.title: U.S. government debt yields are surging at a bad time. Here's what's behind the move
item.description: Fixed income market watchers ascribe a run that began in June to a number of variables.

item.title: Disney-owned ABC files First Amendment lawsuit against FCC
item.description: Disney's ABC has sued the FCC claiming its investigation and early broadcast licenses renewal are a "retaliatory campaign" due to its programming.

item.title: Income investors need to 'wake up' to the new market regime. Where to find solid yields now
item.description: With Kevin Warsh heading the Federal Reserve, investors have to accept the reality of a new market regime, said Luis Alvarado at Wells Fargo.

item.title: Data centers, crypto, and tax revisions take center stage in Tuesday primaries
item.description: Incumbent Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan of Alaska is facing a serious challenge from former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola.

item.title: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.33%, new 19-year high on inflation, spending concerns
item.description: Long-dated fixed income hit their highest level in almost two decades amid a worsening U.S. fiscal situation and persistently higher inflation.

item.title: Meta faces ‘astronomical’ consequences as legal fight reaches critical moment in California
item.description: Meta faces a federal trial over child safety claims that could bring major financial penalties and changes to Facebook and Instagram.

item.title: Lakers governor Jeanie Buss says siblings cannot sell family’s stake to Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner
item.description: Jeanie Buss's lawyer says she has not agreed to sell the team and that any vote suggesting the Buss family is selling "would be and is void."

item.title: The top 10 colleges for financial aid in 2026, according to The Princeton Review — and what families actually pay
item.description: With cost a top concern, these colleges are considered the most generous with their financial aid packages.

item.title: Apple overhauls Europe app store fees to resolve payments clash
item.description: The iPhone maker said the changes "resolve" disagreements with regulators stemming from the implementation of Europe's Digital Markets Act.

item.title: What the Meta Platforms trial means for investors
item.description: Meta could pay hundreds of billions in damages, but potential changes to how content is served are a bigger concern for shareholders

item.title: The market is broadening and it’s time to look beyond megacap tech. Three charts show why
item.description: The secular bull market is ongoing and becoming more widespread with participation from stocks in areas outside of tech and energy.

item.title: Analysis: Bond market pressure is squeezing Main Street as Wall Street waits on Warsh
item.description: A sell-off in long-term Treasurys is raising borrowing costs, exposing how debt, AI spending and energy are turning the bond market into a political problem.

item.title: American Airlines to add seatback screens, bigger first class in race to catch up to Delta and United
item.description: American is trying to add more premium seating and passenger perks after falling behind rivals Delta and United.

item.title: Hims & Hers CEO says FTC lawsuit misunderstands how the company works
item.description: Hims & Hers CEO Andrew Dudum spoke to CNBC about the FTC's lawsuit against the company, compounded GLP-1 drugs and AI.

item.title: Kalshi seeks to launch ‘perps’ on equity indexes as it moves in on traditional exchanges' turf
item.description: The company is seeking to launch a "US500" perp tied to the MerQube U.S. Large Cap Index, according to a regulatory filing.

item.title: Home Depot reaffirms guidance amid 'frozen housing market conditions'
item.description: Home Depot reported second fiscal quarter results that beat Wall Street expectations on the top and bottom lines.

item.title: We upgraded Home Depot and raised our price target. It made the best of a terrible hand
item.description: Home Depot reported a very good quarter, executing well on things it can control.

item.title: Can you get a personal loan the same day you apply? Here's what you'll need
item.description: If you need funding in a pinch, follow these steps for getting a personal loan the same (or next business) day.

item.title: Contrarian vs. the crowd: One trader made a massive bet against chip stocks
item.description: The biggest single options trade in the entire market Monday was a $129 million bet against the VanEck Semiconductor ETF.

item.title: Nvidia's AI moat is shifting from chips to capital
item.description: Nvidia still has dominant market share in AI chips, but with competition picking up steam, the company is taking greater advantage of another key asset.

item.title: A fintech app built by crypto exchange Kraken just launched a cash back debit card in bid for consumer wallets
item.description: Kraken is vying for a place in consumer wallets as crypto evolves from an asset class into infrastructure for mainstream financial products.

item.title: Cyclospora is changing the American workplace lunch: 'We switched our marketing immediately,' says Saladworks CEO
item.description: Amid the country's ongoing cyclospora outbreak, salad-focused restaurants like Sweetgreen and Saladworks are shifting their marketing.

item.title: Sea Ray parent Brunswick bets on AI navigation and new revenue streams to help stalling boat sales
item.description: Brunswick Corp. CEO David Foulkes told CNBC premium boat sales are staying afloat, while value options are lagging.

item.title: IRS clarifies 'no tax on overtime' deduction rules. What workers need to know
item.description: Taxpayers who were unsure whether they qualified or how much they could claim will likely have an easier time when they file their 2026 tax returns, experts say.

item.title: 'Worrisome': AI is driving a looming market correction, European central bank economists warn
item.description: History suggests valuations will tumble even if they are a fair reflection of the transformative power of AI, according to a European Central Bank analysis.

item.title: Millennials and Gen Z are landing fast-growing, high-paying AI jobs, according to LinkedIn study
item.description: Young workers are holding their own in the AI job market, according to new research from LinkedIn.
